description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractClient' which serves as a base for implementing JMeter samplers that connect to the Hono platform. It manages a Vertx instance configured with specific DNS resolution options and provides a method to close this instance asynchronously.

classes.name: AbstractClient
classes.description: An abstract class providing common setup for Vertx client connections to Hono with DNS configuration and lifecycle management.

methods.name: AbstractClient()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Vertx instance with specific options.

methods.name: vertx()
methods.description: Creates and configures a new Vertx instance with DNS and warning exception settings.

methods.name: closeVertx()
methods.description: Closes the Vertx instance asynchronously and returns a Future that completes upon closure.
